pages.text: Before moving a machine, remove its stored inputs and outputs if you need those resources separately. Some machine drops keep charge, inventory, or settings. Read the carried item’s tooltip.
Many machines have a shapeless reset recipe that takes the carried machine by itself. The reset discards the saved contents and settings. Check the output preview before taking it.

To rebuild a conduit line, keep the configured filters and use the $(l:enderio:conduits/tools)Conduit Probe$(/l) to copy endpoint settings. Restore the connected face, then verify the path with a few resources.
